context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the library's expression evaluation API to parse and compute mathematical expressions from strings. It checks that the implementation properly passes a scope/variables object to the evaluation call and that all supported expression types produce correct results.

checklist.name: Uses evaluate API
checklist.description: The implementation calls the library's expression evaluation function (evaluate or compile+evaluate) to process expression strings rather than implementing its own parser.

checklist.name: Passes scope correctly
checklist.description: The variables object is correctly passed as the scope argument to the evaluate call so that variable names resolve to the given values.

checklist.name: Handles no-variable expressions
checklist.description: Expressions with no variables (pure numeric expressions including built-in functions) evaluate to the correct result.

checklist.name: Handles multi-variable expressions
checklist.description: Expressions using multiple variables (e.g. x^2 + y^2) correctly substitute all provided variables and return the right value.

checklist.name: Returns numeric result
checklist.description: The function returns a plain JavaScript number, not a string or a library-specific object.
